items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 19:1
items.html: This was already explained in Answer 12: it is the power of the Malchut of the first restriction found in the inner NHY above the Yesod, called the two male testicles, which holds the power of heating that causes the female waters to rise in order to draw the missing AHAP. And by this heating the aspect of the female waters is perfected so that they are fit for the generation of souls — namely, to draw the aspect of a drop from the ten Sefirot that are completed with the AHAP. For without it there would be no arousal whatsoever in the Malchut of the second restriction, from which come all the aspects of the couplings of Atzilut, that could raise female waters to draw these AHAP missing to it; for since it was emanated so from its very beginning, it does not feel its own deficiency. Hence this assistance of the Malchut of the first restriction is called the cooking of the seed, or the cooking of the female waters, for from its power comes this perfection that makes it fit for seed and for female waters sufficient to draw male waters for the generation of souls. However, the very essence of the female waters, upon which the coupling and the descent of the male waters are made, is not from this Malchut of the first restriction, for there is no coupling upon it in all the Partzufim of ABYA, as is known. Hence the aspect of its participation in the female waters is called only 'the cooking of the seed' — that is, it prepares and perfects the female waters, but it is not the essence of the female waters themselves. Understand this. (Part 1, Page 328, Item 74).
